title: Transmission lines · HIFLD · county
description: Kilometers of transmission line inside each county by voltage class, their sum, the highest voltage present, and whether the county has any line. Lengths are measured inside the county; a line that crosses a boundary is counted only for the part inside. Alaska and Hawaii are not covered and have empty values.

fields.description: Unit code of the boundaries release: ISO3-level-national code, e.g. USA-2-51059.

fields.name: fips
fields.description: County FIPS code, 5 digits, kept as a string (leading zeros matter).

fields.name: name
fields.description: Unit name as published in the boundaries release.

fields.name: coverage_status
fields.description: covered: the unit is inside the area the source was processed for; not_covered: outside it, all values are empty (not zero).

fields.name: max_voltage_kv

null_meaning.not_covered: The county is in Alaska or Hawaii, which this release does not cover; it was not processed.
null_meaning.covered: The county has no line, or none of its lines has a recorded voltage.

fields.description: Highest voltage among the lines inside the county that have a recorded voltage.

null_meaning.not_covered: The county is in Alaska or Hawaii, which this release does not cover; it was not processed.

fields.description: True if at least one line of the source file touches the county. It can be true while km_total is 0, when the length inside the county is below the rounding of the kilometer columns.

null_meaning.covered: The county has no line length inside it, so the share is undefined.

fields.description: Share of the line length inside the county that has no recorded voltage, from 0 to 1.

coverage.geography: Contiguous United States and the District of Columbia
known_gaps: Alaska and Hawaii are not covered.

HIFLD Open, the public portal that distributed this file, was discontinued by the U.S. Department of Homeland Security on 26 August 2025; the announcement gave no reason. The layer uses an archived copy of the national file (copy of 26 February 2026; newest record 26 September 2024). Other public archives of the file exist, for example DataLumos (DOI 10.3886/E240591V1); which archive our copy came from was not recorded, and it has not been matched to them record by record.
Twelve county-equivalents have no line inside them.
Hamilton County, Iowa (19079) and Clare County, Michigan (26035) have a line inside them shorter than 0.5 km, so km_total is 0 while has_any_line is true.
The layer does not show how much power can flow into a county.
The archive carries no dataset metadata; license status is taken from the publisher's metadata for the same edition (30 Sep 2024).

verification.method: Line lengths inside each county are computed by script from the segments of the archive and classed by voltage. No value was re-checked by a person or by an agent. The automated checks listed below were run on every build.

automated_checks.description: SHA-256 of every input file was computed at the start and again at the end of the build; they match.
The file has exactly one row for each of the 3,144 USA ADM2 units of the boundaries release; 3,109 are covered and 35 are not_covered with empty values.
Every unit_id of the layer exists in the boundaries release and no unit_id is repeated.
Columns of the CSV, GeoParquet and GeoJSON files equal fields[] in composition and order.
The sum of every numeric column read back from the published CSV equals the sum in the input table.
km_total > 0 exactly when has_any_line was tested for every covered unit; 2 divergences (lines shorter than rounding) are listed in the release report.
Originator, other constraints and use limitation cut from the saved copy of the publisher's metadata for the same edition (PSU Data Commons) and compared with the expected public-domain wording.
